snippet.title: Coldwake - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Coldwake is a text-driven mystery set in the icy aftermath of a global collapse. Armed with nothing but an old terminal and your curiosity, you’ll dig through corrupted logs, hidden directories, and fragmented memories buried in a forgotten facility. Every command you type is a key—one that might unlock a lost file, a piece of a shattered mind, or a chilling secret about what really happened beneath the snow.

🎮 Wishlist on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3526340/Coldwake?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video
